synthesis: The Scout Org Map (admin Bird's Eye) driver picker (DriverSelector.vue, admin-only via mapStore.adminMode, backed by GET /scout/org-map/api/drivers -> ClarityScoutBirdsEyeController::drivers()) currently lists every non-deleted Scout kit in the org with no regard for scan activity — the endpoint is pure Postgres (Kit + KitSettings), never touches ClickHouse, and never receives the admin's selected date-range (today/7d/15d/30d/60d). DEV-2293 wants the picker narrowed to only drivers with >=1 scan inside that same window, refetching when the range changes, with an empty-state message when nobody qualifies, while leaving every other Bird's Eye behavior (kit_ids scoping of stats/hits/paths, the nameplate toggle, driver-side surfaces) untouched.

scope.summary: Add range-awareness to exactly one endpoint (drivers()): compute the ClickHouse-derived set of kit_ids that scanned in the requested window and ANNOTATE each roster entry with active_in_range (do NOT shrink the roster). Frontend passes the active range + refetches on range change; DriverSelector shows only active drivers by default, reveals inactive matches WITH A NOTE on search, and shows an empty-state when zero active. orgScoutKits()/scopedKits() stay range-agnostic (shared by other endpoints); store.drivers stays the full roster so App.vue followedDriverName/noKitsReporting + AC4 are untouched.

proposed_changes.change: drivers() reads+whitelists a `range` query param (same ladder + fallback-to-'today' as scanPaths()), resolves [start,end] via getDateRange($range,$tz), computes the set of kit_ids with >=1 scan in-window via a new private helper, and adds an `active_in_range` boolean to each mapped roster entry (kit_id in the active set). It returns the FULL orgScoutKits() roster annotated — it does NOT filter the list server-side. Cache the active-kit-id lookup per org+range with mapCacheTtl($range). Do NOT touch orgScoutKits()'s own cache — scopedKits() reuses it unfiltered.
proposed_changes.reason: AC1 default-visible filtering + Q1 search-reveal both fall out of the annotated roster; keeps store.drivers whole (AC4 + App.vue consumers untouched)

(b) When search text is present, also include inactive matches, rendered with a distinct note/dim (e.g. 'inactive in this range') — Q1 surface-with-a-note. questions.q: Search-by-name UX: if a driver has NO scans in the selected range but the admin searches for them by name, should they be surfaced (with a note) or strictly hidden?
questions.answer: Surface with a note. DESIGN: drivers() returns the FULL org roster with an added active_in_range boolean per entry (true if kit_id is in the CH distinct-kit_id set for the range) rather than shrinking the list. DriverSelector shows only active_in_range entries by default; when the admin types a search, inactive matches are ALSO shown, visually flagged (e.g. dimmed + 'inactive in this range'). This keeps store.drivers the full roster.

questions.q: Selected/followed-driver pruning: if the admin is following/selecting a driver and changes the range so that driver becomes inactive, should the picker drop them (and clear the follow), or keep the selection silently?
questions.answer: Keep the selection silently. Automatic under the annotated-full-roster design: the selected/followed driver stays in store.drivers (just active_in_range=false), so the chip + followedDriverName banner still resolve normally and no pruning/reconciliation logic is needed.

questions.q: Mid-session refresh (AC2 scope): should the driver list refresh only on an explicit range change, or also on the ~10s live tick?
questions.answer: Only on range change. fetchDrivers() stays OUT of the useBirdsEyePolling live tick — no added per-tick CH read. Satisfies AC2's literal wording.

questions.q: Feature-route design approval: filter server-side in drivers() via a bounded distinct-kit_id ClickHouse read (reusing the stats() forWindow/final/forOrg pattern) + reuse the existing range-change watcher, honoring the full 5-value range ladder (today/7/15/30/60)?
questions.answer: Approved. Honor the full 5-value ladder (default unknown -> today). Refinement from Q1: annotate the roster with active_in_range rather than shrinking store.drivers, so App.vue followedDriverName/noKitsReporting and AC4 stay untouched and the search-reveal is a pure client-side concern over the annotated list.

questions.q: Does a driver who is live/driving but has ZERO scans yet today count as 'active'?
questions.answer: No — AC1 literally says 'at least one scan'; the only activity signal for this endpoint is scans_hot/scans_cold. sc_positions (live GPS) is a separate feed and is not proposed to be unioned in.
